test.create_query: CREATE TABLE proj (CounterID UInt32, EventDate Date, EventTime DateTime, UserID UInt64, RegionID UInt32, ResolutionWidth UInt16) ENGINE = MergeTree PARTITION BY intHash32(UserID) % 8 ORDER BY (CounterID, EventDate, intHash32(UserID), EventTime) SETTINGS old_parts_lifetime = 10
CREATE TABLE proj_keys (UserID UInt64) ENGINE = MergeTree ORDER BY UserID

CREATE TABLE proj_parts ( CounterID UInt32, EventDate Date, EventTime DateTime, UserID UInt64, WatchID UInt64, RegionID UInt32, ResolutionWidth UInt16, PROJECTION pn_user (SELECT * ORDER BY UserID), PROJECTION pn_region (SELECT * ORDER BY RegionID), PROJECTION pn_time (SELECT * ORDER BY EventTime), PROJECTION pa_cd (SELECT CounterID, EventDate, count(), sum(ResolutionWidth), uniq(UserID) GROUP BY CounterID, EventDate), PROJECTION pa_cr (SELECT CounterID, RegionID, count(), sum(ResolutionWidth), uniq(UserID) GROUP BY CounterID, RegionID), PROJECTION pa_rd (SELECT RegionID, EventDate, count(), sum(ResolutionWidth), uniq(UserID) GROUP BY RegionID, EventDate) ) ENGINE = MergeTree PARTITION BY toUInt32(EventTime) % 3000 ORDER BY (CounterID, EventDate, intHash32(UserID), EventTime) SETTINGS index_granularity = 256, old_parts_lifetime = 10
test.fill_query: INSERT INTO proj SELECT CounterID, EventDate, EventTime, UserID, RegionID, ResolutionWidth FROM hits_100m_single SETTINGS max_insert_threads = 16, max_partitions_per_insert_block = 0
ALTER TABLE proj MODIFY SETTING lock_acquire_timeout_for_background_operations = 600
OPTIMIZE TABLE proj FINAL SETTINGS optimize_throw_if_noop = 1, optimize_skip_merged_partitions = 1
SELECT throwIf((count(), uniqExact(partition), sum(rows)) != (8, 8, 100000000)) FROM system.parts WHERE database = 'default' AND table = 'proj' AND active

ALTER TABLE proj ADD PROJECTION p_user (SELECT * ORDER BY UserID), ADD PROJECTION p_agg (SELECT CounterID, EventDate, count(), sum(ResolutionWidth), uniq(UserID) GROUP BY CounterID, EventDate), ADD PROJECTION p_agg_half (SELECT CounterID, EventDate, count(), sum(ResolutionWidth), uniq(UserID) GROUP BY CounterID, EventDate)
ALTER TABLE proj CLEAR PROJECTION p_user, MATERIALIZE PROJECTION p_user SETTINGS mutations_sync = 2
SELECT throwIf((count(), sum(rows)) != (8, 100000000)) FROM system.projection_parts WHERE database = 'default' AND table = 'proj' AND name = 'p_user' AND active

SELECT throwIf((count(), sum(cityHash64(CounterID, EventDate, EventTime, UserID, RegionID, ResolutionWidth))) != (100000000, 1099098086923679816)) FROM proj WHERE UserID > 0 SETTINGS force_optimize_projection = 1, preferred_optimize_projection_name = 'p_user', force_optimize_projection_name = 'p_user'
ALTER TABLE proj CLEAR PROJECTION p_user, MATERIALIZE PROJECTION p_user SETTINGS mutations_sync = 2
SELECT throwIf((count(), sum(rows)) != (8, 100000000)) FROM system.projection_parts WHERE database = 'default' AND table = 'proj' AND name = 'p_user' AND active

SELECT throwIf((count(), sum(cityHash64(CounterID, EventDate, EventTime, UserID, RegionID, ResolutionWidth))) != (100000000, 1099098086923679816)) FROM proj WHERE UserID > 0 SETTINGS force_optimize_projection = 1, preferred_optimize_projection_name = 'p_user', force_optimize_projection_name = 'p_user'
ALTER TABLE proj CLEAR PROJECTION p_agg, MATERIALIZE PROJECTION p_agg SETTINGS mutations_sync = 2
SELECT throwIf((count(), sum(rows)) != (8, 123789)) FROM system.projection_parts WHERE database = 'default' AND table = 'proj' AND name = 'p_agg' AND active

SELECT throwIf((count(), sum(cityHash64(CounterID, c, s, u))) != (6506, 613506612325587037)) FROM (SELECT CounterID, count() AS c, sum(ResolutionWidth) AS s, uniq(UserID) AS u FROM proj GROUP BY CounterID) SETTINGS force_optimize_projection_name = 'p_agg'

ALTER TABLE proj MATERIALIZE PROJECTION p_agg_half IN PARTITION 0, MATERIALIZE PROJECTION p_agg_half IN PARTITION 1, MATERIALIZE PROJECTION p_agg_half IN PARTITION 2, MATERIALIZE PROJECTION p_agg_half IN PARTITION 3 SETTINGS mutations_sync = 2
SELECT throwIf((countIf(name = 'p_user'), countIf(name = 'p_agg'), countIf(name = 'p_agg_half')) != (8, 8, 4)) FROM system.projection_parts WHERE database = 'default' AND table = 'proj' AND active

SELECT throwIf((count(), sum(cityHash64(CounterID, c, s, u))) != (6506, 613506612325587037)) FROM (SELECT CounterID, count() AS c, sum(ResolutionWidth) AS s, uniq(UserID) AS u FROM proj GROUP BY CounterID) SETTINGS preferred_optimize_projection_name = 'p_agg_half', force_optimize_projection_name = 'p_agg_half'
INSERT INTO proj_keys SELECT DISTINCT UserID FROM hits_100m_single WHERE cityHash64(UserID) % 8192 = 0
SELECT throwIf(count() != 2071) FROM proj_keys
SELECT throwIf((count(), sum(ResolutionWidth), uniqExact(RegionID)) != (12467, 16373756, 360)) FROM proj WHERE UserID IN proj_keys SETTINGS log_comment = 'projections_hits.r1'

INSERT INTO proj_parts SELECT CounterID, EventDate, EventTime, UserID, WatchID, RegionID, ResolutionWidth FROM hits_10m_single SETTINGS max_insert_threads = 1, min_insert_block_size_rows = 1000000000, min_insert_block_size_bytes = 0, max_insert_block_size = 1000000000, max_partitions_per_insert_block = 0

SELECT throwIf(arraySort(groupArray(s)) != [1839, 1840, 1841, 1842]) FROM ( SELECT sum(ResolutionWidth) AS s FROM proj_parts WHERE WatchID = 6917558722909864349 UNION ALL SELECT sum(ResolutionWidth) + 1 FROM proj_parts WHERE WatchID = 6917558722909864349 UNION ALL SELECT sum(ResolutionWidth) + 2 FROM proj_parts WHERE WatchID = 6917558722909864349 UNION ALL SELECT sum(ResolutionWidth) + 3 FROM proj_parts WHERE WatchID = 6917558722909864349 ) SETTINGS log_comment = 'projections_hits.p3'
SYSTEM FLUSH LOGS query_log

SELECT throwIf(groupArray((log_comment, projections)) != [('projections_hits.p3', []), ('projections_hits.r1', ['default.proj.p_user'])]) FROM ( SELECT log_comment, projections FROM system.query_log WHERE type = 'QueryFinish' AND log_comment IN ('projections_hits.p3', 'projections_hits.r1') AND event_time >= (SELECT metadata_modification_time FROM system.tables WHERE database = 'default' AND name = 'proj') ORDER BY log_comment )
